categories.main_business_segments: ELAN Corporation's primary business segment is the 'Care Support (CS) Set' service, which provides rental of clothing and towels with laundry services, combined with the provision of daily necessities, mainly to patients in hospitals and residents in elderly care facilities. The company operates almost exclusively in the healthcare and elderly care support sector, with all significant revenue derived from this segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core operational method is a service platform that integrates the rental and laundering of clothing and towels with the supply of daily necessities, managed through proprietary systems for order, billing, and logistics. The company leverages IT systems for efficient contract management, billing, and customer support, and partners with linen supply companies and logistics providers for fulfillment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are individual patients admitted to hospitals and residents of elderly care facilities, including nursing homes and group homes. The main end markets are the healthcare and elderly care sectors in Japan, with recent expansion into hospital laundry services in Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in Japan, with 29 branches and offices covering all major regions. Internationally, it has expanded into Vietnam through the acquisition of hospital laundry service providers, aiming for further growth in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: ELAN operates at the downstream end of the supply chain, directly interfacing with end-users (patients and residents) and contracting with hospitals and care facilities. It coordinates with midstream partners such as linen suppliers and logistics companies for service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include nationwide expansion of the CS Set service, enhancement of service value through IT and DX (digital transformation), and development of new business areas leveraging customer data and relationships. The company is also focusing on overseas expansion, particularly in emerging Asian markets, and on sustainability initiatives such as GHG reduction and ESG/SDGs compliance. There is no significant in-house R&D; innovation is mainly in service design and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through daily-rate subscription fees paid by individual users for the CS Set service, calculated based on the number of days of use rather than consumption volume. Additional revenue comes from the sale of daily necessities and, overseas, from hospital laundry service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include other companies offering hospital admission sets and care-related services, as well as linen supply and daily goods providers entering the market. ELAN is a market leader in Japan for hospital and care facility admission sets, with a strong brand and nationwide presence, but faces increasing competition from both established and new entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated sales reached approximately 47.5 billion yen, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 2.35 billion yen. The company has shown steady double-digit revenue growth in recent years, driven by facility expansion and user growth, though profit margins have slightly declined due to cost pressures and investments. The workforce has expanded to 676 employees (including temporary staff), and the company maintains a strong balance sheet with a 57.9% equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ELAN's unique value lies in its 'hands-free' admission and discharge experience for patients and residents, eliminating the need for families to prepare or manage clothing and daily necessities. The daily-rate, all-inclusive pricing model offers predictability and convenience, while the company’s nationwide network, operational expertise, and strong relationships with healthcare institutions provide a competitive edge. Its focus on customer satisfaction, service customization, and integration with facility operations further differentiates it from competitors.
